title: GuidedVLA: Specifying Task-Relevant Factors via Plug-and-Play Action Attention Specialization
authors: Xiaosong Jia*, Bowen Yang*, Zuhao Ge*, Xian Nie*, Yuchen Zhou*, Cunxin Fan*, et al. Equal contribution.
description: We guide VLA action decoders to focus on task-relevant factors by assigning dedicated attention heads to object grounding, temporal skill logic, and spatial geometry.

authors: Yujie Zang*, Yuhang Zheng*, Xian Nie*, Yupeng Zheng, Shuai Tian, Songen Gu, Chen Gao, Zining Wang, Shuicheng Yan, Wenchao Ding
description: A force-guided tactile world model for contact-rich robotic manipulation.

title: IPR-1: Interactive Physical Reasoner
authors: M Zhang, L Zhuo, T Tan, G Xie, X Nie, Y Li, R Zhao, Z He, Z Wang, J Cai, et al.

title: Contact Trajectory Prompting: In-Context Transfer of Contact-Rich Behaviors from a Single Demonstration
authors: Xian Nie*, Yujie Zang*, Yuhang Zheng*, Yupeng Zheng, Songen Gu, Wendi Chen, Chuan Wen, Cewu Lu, Wenchao Ding, Junchi Yan, Shuicheng Yan. Equal contribution.
description: We encode motion and contact information from a single demonstration into an ordered prompt, enabling a fixed policy to transfer contact-rich behaviors to unseen objects using online sensory feedback.
